title.narrative: Advancing the right to education and early childhood care and education

description.narrative: This project advances the right to education throughout life through a rights-based, inclusive and equity-driven approach, with particular attention to those most at risk of exclusion. It supports Member States in strengthening legal, policy and accountability frameworks in line with international human rights standards. Key activities include the implementation of UNESCO’s recent methodological guidance tools, enhanced monitoring and reporting, policy and legislative support, and follow-up to international commitments. In line with 2022 Tashkent Declaration and UNESCO's Initiative on the Evolving Right to Education, particular emphasis is placed on early childhood care and education as a foundation for foundational and lifelong learning, ensuring that the most vulnerable learners are not left behind from the earliest years.
